news.signals module

Provision role groups and keep inapplicable subscription tables empty.

These signals handle user roles and groups only. Article approval does not use signals; it follows option 2 of the brief (see services.py).

news.signals.provision_groups(sender, **kwargs)[source]

Create the three role groups and give them their permissions.

  • Reader: view articles and newsletters.

  • Editor: view, change and delete articles and newsletters, plus add newsletters.

  • Journalist: add, view, change and delete articles and newsletters.

news.signals.remember_role(sender, instance, raw=False, **kwargs)[source]

Store the user’s role before saving, to detect role changes.

news.signals.synchronise_role(sender, instance, raw=False, created=False, **kwargs)[source]

Put the user in the group for their role and clear other fields.

Fields that belong to another role are emptied, which is how the “assign the other role’s fields None” requirement is enforced in the database (a many-to-many field cannot store None itself).

news.signals.validate_subscriptions(sender, instance, action, reverse, pk_set, **kwargs)[source]

Reject subscriptions that break the role rules.

Only readers may subscribe, and journalist subscriptions must point at journalists. Both directions of the relation are checked.
